question: What was the unemployment rate (UR) in urban areas as of January – March 2024 for persons of age 15 years and above?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A - 2, B - 1, C - 4, D - 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **National Nutrition Plan**:

 
 
• **National Nutrition Mission** was launched in **2001-02** to provide **free foodgrains** to **under-nourished, pregnant, and lactating women and adolescent girls** belonging to **below-poverty-line**.
 
• As the **first intervention**, the Government launched a pilot project last year, in **51** nutritionally deficient districts in the country with the release of special additional central assistance of Rs. 103.33 crore to the states. 
 
 
 
• **Swajal Dhara Yojana**:
 
 
• **Swajaldhara Yojna **was **launched** by Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpai** in** 2002-03,** to provide drinking water to all the villages in the shortest possible time at minimum cost.
 
• Under the scheme, **10% of the cost** of the project would be contributed by the **villagers** while the remaining **90%** would be borne by the **Union Government**.
 
 
 
• **Universal Health Insurance Plan:**
 
 
• **​**The **Universal Health Insurance Scheme **(**UHIS**) launched by the Government of India in **2003-04** is already in existence for persons and families below the poverty line with an element of subsidy from the Government.
 
 
 
• **Hariyali Project:**
 
 
• The** ​Hariyali Project** was launched in **January 2003** for **watershed programmes** being implemented through **Panchayati Raj Institutions**.
 
• Under this initiative, all ongoing area development programmes namely, the Integrated Wastelands Development Programme (IWDP), Drought Prone Areas Programme (DPAP) and Desert Development Programme (DDP) would be implemented through Panchayati Raj Institutions.
